name: Top processes by CPU and memory (Windows)
description: Lists the busiest processes by current CPU use and by working set memory.

params.name: top_n
params.label: Number of processes
params.description: How many processes to list in each ranking (1 to 50).

output: Two tables: top CPU and top memory. CPU is a one-moment sample summed across cores. Exit 0; exit 2 on a bad top_n.
